answer: Registration is free; earning is not. Each epoch asks every key for original text on a pearl that rotates unpredictably. Rewards vest over many epochs while transfers do not. A farm cannot convert one lucky grade into liquid value, and each extra key adds only slow capped income, so the vertex of a farm stays negative before any balance matures. The atlas ends up backed by cognition that cannot be stockpiled, transferred, or pre-bought, which is exactly what proof-of-work and proof-of-stake cannot offer. Seal 1fqpk.
